title: A Simple Model of Gas Flow in a Porous Powder Compact
cover_release_statement: Approved for public release; further dissemination unlimited.
source_typo_note: Text immediately after equation 35 reverses the mechanism names of the two RHS terms; equations 23/34 identify B*P_avg/viscosity as viscous and D_K as Knudsen.
scope: Uniform fixed porosity; ideal pure gas; isothermal constant viscosity; low Reynolds and Mach numbers. Supplemental independent confirmation, not measured brick input.
